description: Gefahrenhinweisbereich Erdfälle/Dolinen is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by umweltatlas.bayern.de. In the areas shown here, sinkholes and earthfalls could be determined using a high-resolution digital elevation model and various other sources of information. In the context of these structures, further potential burglaries are to be expected in the future. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Hazard warning area Earthfalls/Dolines" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Doline, Massenbewegung, inspireidentifiziert, Gefahrenhinweiskarte, gdiby, Erdfall. The listing shows 4 download or service links in WMS, WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
